question: How did Bildad end his description of the wicked man in Job 18?
options: He promised Job would be restored
He said God forgives every sin
He said such is the place of one who does not know God
He asked Job to forgive him
explanation: Bildad ended, 'Surely such is the dwelling of an evil man; such is the place of one who does not know God.' He was implying Job was that kind of man.
